notes: «أبى رحمه الله» is the compiler's father, given as relation with no earlier name in the text
«بإسناد يرفعه» is a phrase for an omitted chain, not a name, so it adds no link
«أبي عبد الله» is the Imam in whose tent the narrator was; the text reports his words as seen, not as a transmission, so he is not written as a link; this is a judgment call
offsets after the first links are approximate
